claims: NASA's Artemis II mission successfully lifted off from Kennedy Space Center in Florida
NASA's Artemis II mission lifted off on Wednesday, April 1, 2026
NASA's Artemis II mission lifted off at 6:35 p.m. EDT
The Artemis II mission launched from Pad 39B
The Artemis II mission is a crewed rocket mission
The Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission around the moon
The Artemis II mission marks the first human flight to the lunar vicinity since 1972
Artemis II is a Crewed Lunar Flyby mission
The astronauts on the Artemis II mission are Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, Jeremy Hansen
The status of the Artemis II mission is successfully launched
